item.title: Week 10: Dolphins at Colts
item.description: Sun 11/15 · 1:00 PM ET | Line: IND -4.5 · O/U 37.5 | Model IND 58% vs. market 66% | On paper, Indianapolis has the edge on the ground: it ranks 7th in EPA per designed run (-0.04) against a Miami defense ranked 31st (-0.07 allowed). Miami's counter is explosives, ranked 22nd in explosive play rate (8.4%) against an Indianapolis defense ranked 31st (9.5% allowed). Daniel Jones is the x-factor at -1.30 EPA per dropback under pressure, 30th of 31, facing a Miami pass rush ranked 14th (23% of dropbacks), though no Miami quarterback rank is listed for comparison. The model favors Indianapolis at 58% win probability, led by the rushing matchup (3.5 points) and home field (1.7 points).
